summary: The proposed patch addresses a specific issue with QuerySet optimization methods on proxy models but may introduce broader behavioral changes.

issues.description: Changing `cur_model` to `cur_model._meta.concrete_model` could affect how proxy models are handled in other parts of the codebase, potentially leading to unintended side effects.
While the patch fixes the immediate issue, additional tests should be added to cover various scenarios involving proxy models and QuerySet optimization methods.
